message: COPY AUDITLOG (line 35) and COPY ERRHAND (line 36) sit directly in the FILE SECTION before any FD; neither copybook contains an FD. SELECT AUDIT-FILE (line 17) and SELECT ERROR-FILE (line 23) therefore have no FD/record. The copybook records are linked by EXPANDS_COPY from the FILE section (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0048-SEC-0002), not registered as FILE records, and carry no fd_name.
RECORD KEY AUD-KEY (SELECT AUDIT-FILE, line 20) and RECORD KEY ERR-KEY (SELECT ERROR-FILE, line 26) are not declared in the program or in the expanded copybooks AUDITLOG, ERRHAND, RTNCODE.
ERRHAND is copied into the FILE SECTION; its non-88 items carry VALUE clauses (ERRHAND lines 12-15, 21-25, 45-48, 51-56). Recorded as literal text only.
